Contract ManageSupplierCRUDService::createSupplier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		let newSupplier: Supplier in
		newSupplier.oclIsNew() and
		Supplier.allInstance()->includes(newSupplier) and
		newSupplier.Id = id and
		newSupplier.Name = name and
		supplier.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = true or
		supplier.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		result = false
}
